ache.title: Deep guides can make a game feel like homework
ache.note: Anomalies in Zenless Zone Zero, in depth. Learning a system can be genuinely fun. But the deeper the guide, the more it hints that playing casually is playing wrong, and the more you want the characters that make the system “work.” Understanding is free. Optimising can get pricey.
watch: system mastery tied to new pulls
ache.tip: Learn the mechanic with characters you own. If it’s only fun with new pulls, it isn’t the mechanic you love.
lines: learning is free. let’s keep it that way
casual play is not wrong play
anomalies? the anomaly is your bedtime
